family: The single total certificate-prefix language F defined completely in proof.md and family.py. At actual length N, let k be the least prime at least the least positive integer B with B^5>32*N^3; read k input bits as the low coefficients of a monic degree-k polynomial Q over F_2, reject Q unless the explicit Frobenius/gcd irreducibility test passes, and evaluate the descending-power BK symmetric polynomial on the remaining N-k bits with zero padding, r=ceil((N-k)/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)). Output 0 at N=0 and at every explicitly stated failed guard. The result is the constant coefficient in F_2[Z]/Q. Every prefix bit is included in N; Q is input, not advice.
theorem: This one fixed total language is in P, hence in NP with empty witnesses. In the full pinned Li--Yang B2 model there exist a fixed real K>0 and an integer N0 such that C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-K*N^(4/5) for EVERY integer N>=N0. More precisely, the proof displays R(N)=4*k+10*(floor(k*r/t)+k*t+r*(r+1)+1), proves C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-R(N) eventually, and bounds that same R(N) by K*N^(4/5). K and N0 depend only on the fixed theorem. Consequently C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-o(N) and liminf_N C_B2(F_N)/N>=4.
